name: Reveal Footer
summary: A footer uncovered from beneath the page as you scroll, with a rising CTA heading, directional-underline links, a live status dot and an oversized cropped wordmark lit by a pointer spotlight.
useWhen: A marketing or product page should end with a dramatic closing footer that is revealed from under the content
A brand wordmark, a final call to action and a system status indicator belong together at the page end
avoidWhen: The footer must sit inside a scrolling panel or a narrow column, because the reveal is driven by the window scroll
The footer needs a newsletter form or a dot-field texture; marketing/dithered-footer fits better
The footer needs a halftone or illustrated scene; marketing/halftone-footer or marketing/hills-footer fit better
